record.question: Who was awarded the Golden Glove Award in FIFA World Cup 2014?
record.explanation: UEFA’s dated 13 July 2014 post-tournament awards record names Manuel Neuer, Germany, as Golden Glove winner. This is the historical 2014 award, with no current-player-status claim. Historical exam context: 2015-01 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed.
